pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Stellate, irregular polygonal regions with non-linear, jagged boundaries. Edges exhibit dendritic projections into the inter-patch corridors. Patch density is higher and individual area is smaller at the anterior shoulder and neck base, while area increases toward the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space with varying pixel thickness. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent or quadrivalent. Pathways exhibit significant narrowing (necking) at points where patch vertices converge.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, low-amplitude serrated profile along the superior neck boundary. The mane presents as a continuous, high-frequency fringe with a darker pixel value than the surrounding tissue.
